title: Hearing on accessibility of city parks and recreation centers
summary: The Council's Committees on Disabilities and Parks and Recreation will hold a joint oversight hearing on the accessibility of New York City parks, playgrounds and recreation centers for people with disabilities. The hearing also covers related bills, including requiring an annual accessibility compliance report from the Parks Department, mandating reduced admission fees for seniors, veterans and people with disabilities, and requiring more accessible swings in playgrounds. The Parks Department oversees more than 30,000 acres of land, including 2,000 parks, 1,000 playgrounds and 37 recreation centers.
